ledger_rules.security_in_treatment: In-kind capital contribution (shares inventory + invested corpus, zero bank cash inflow)
ledger_rules.cash_withdrawals: 0.00 (No cash payouts returned to user; fees & taxes debited from internal cash)
ledger_rules.xirr_cost_basis: Dual Cost Basis: PMS Performance uses Transfer-In Market Price (₹3.74 Cr shares + ₹1.40 Cr cash = ₹5.14 Cr); Investor True XIRR uses Capital Register Historical Purchase Price (₹3.69 Cr shares + ₹1.40 Cr cash = ₹5.09 Cr)

delta_reconciliation_protocol.step_1: Query PmsReconciliationBaseline and PmsReconciliationBaselineHoldings from portfolio.db
delta_reconciliation_protocol.step_2: Fetch only incremental Transactions with date > 2026-08-23 or id > last_reconciled_txn_id
delta_reconciliation_protocol.step_3: Separate Qty on Hand (settled) vs Qty in Transit (T+1/T+2 unsettled DP transfers)
delta_reconciliation_protocol.step_4: Reconcile live bank value = baseline_cash (85,335) + incremental net cash flows
